question: The song ‘Teri mitti’ is from which of the following movies?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kesari**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The song **'Teri mitti'** is from the movie **'Kesari'**.
 
• **Kesari** is a 2019 Indian Hindi-language action-war film starring Akshay Kumar and Parineeti Chopra.
 
• The film is based on the **Battle of Saragarhi**, where 21 soldiers of the Sikh regiment fought valiantly against 10,000 Afghan invaders in 1897.
 
• The song **'Teri mitti'** is a patriotic song that pays tribute to the soldiers who laid down their lives for their country.
 
• The song was composed by **Arko Pravo Mukherjee** and sung by **B Praak**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kesari** was directed by **Anurag Singh** and produced by **Karan Johar**, **Aruna Bhatia**, **Hiroo Yash Johar**, **Apoorva Mehta**, and **Sunir Khetarpal**.
 
• The film received positive reviews from critics and audiences alike, particularly for its performances, action sequences, and music.
 
• The song **'Teri mitti'** became an anthem of sorts for patriotism and is often played during national events and celebrations.
 
• **Kesari** grossed over ₹200 crore worldwide, making it one of the highest-grossing Bollywood films of **2019**.
